record.original_question: Let K be a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob. Is the product space of an arbitrary family of K-determined spaces itself K-determined?

evidence.quote: Question 5.22. ([49]) Let K be a full category of Top0 containing Sob (in particular, a Keimel-Lawson category). Is the product space of an arbitrary family of K-determined spaces K-determined?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category of $T_0$ topological spaces with continuous maps, and let $\mathbf{Sob}$ denote its full subcategory of sober spaces. Let $\mathbf{K}$ be a full subcategory of $\mathbf{Top}_0$ that contains $\mathbf{Sob}$ and is closed under homeomorphisms (a typical example being a Keimel–Lawson category, i.e., a full subcategory of $\mathbf{Top}_0$ containing $\mathbf{Sob}$ that is closed under finite products and equalizers in $\mathbf{Top}_0$, closed under formation of arbitrary subspaces of homeomorphic copies of its members, and closed under topological sums).

For a $T_0$ space $X$, write $\mathcal{O}(X)$ for its lattice of open sets. Define the canonical map
$$\eta_X : X \longrightarrow \prod_{Y\in\mathbf{K},\, f \in \mathbf{Top}_0(X,Y)} Y, \qquad \eta_X(x) = (f(x))_{Y,f},$$
and call $X$ a $\mathbf{K}$-\emph{determined space} if $\eta_X$ is a topological embedding onto a subspace whose image is determined (in the appropriate categorical sense) by $\mathbf{K}$; equivalently, $X$ is $\mathbf{K}$-determined if it is homeomorphic to a subspace of a product of objects of $\mathbf{K}$, i.e., it lies in the epireflective hull of $\mathbf{K}$ in $\mathbf{Top}_0$.

Question: Is the product (in $\mathbf{Top}_0$) of an arbitrary family of $\mathbf{K}$-determined spaces again a $\mathbf{K}$-determined space?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turned up active research on K-determined spaces, well-filtered spaces, and Keimel–Lawson categories (e.g., Xu's work on K-reflections and surveys by Jean Goubault-Larrecq), but no source explicitly resolving whether arbitrary products of K-determined spaces are K-determined for a general full subcategory K of Top_0 containing Sob. The status thus appears to remain open or unresolved in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies K-determined spaces and Keimel-Lawson categories; poses related questions including products.
status_evidence.claim: Source where the question on products of K-determined spaces is raised; no resolution given in available references.

status_evidence.title: A Few Projective Classes of (Non-Hausdorff) Topological Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on projective classes in Top_0; discusses K-determined and related notions but does not settle the product question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to investigate K-determined spaces without resolving the product question.
